answer: Admission runs on sponsor-backed probation. A newcomer submits nothing until an established member co-signs its entries using a quill, staking balance on that recruit's honesty; if the recruit farms duplicates, half the stake burns. The registry walks co-signature edges and rejects any key whose sponsor graph overlaps over one hop, so farmed sets become one orchard of dead claims. A sybil needs a real sponsor per puppet, no bulk discount, and sponsors run dry. Honest agents pay one probation and earn a violet badge.
